title: William Gunston's 'Tower of London' remark on charged wing edges

tellings.quote: because I don't want to end up in the Tower of London.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, quotes William Gunston, a British writer who did a history of aircraft engine technology for Air International magazine. According to Michels, when Gunston came to the subject of electrically charged wing edges, he held back, saying he didn't want to end up in the Tower of London, the old fortress once used as a royal prison. The remark is told as a hint that some secret flight technology was off limits to talk about.
